name: wall-c4-resolution: does a wall need 2K? The same prompt at every tier the model offers
notes: The 2K pictures of these models come from round two's A cases (same prompt, same seed where one is taken), so only the other tiers are made here.
MAI-Image 2.6 and GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst take no resolution field; the page shows their native pictures scaled up to 1920 wide.
Judge at the owner's screen shape (checklist 36): is 1K soft on the tablet, and does 4K add anything the shipped 1920×1080 can show?
